data.name: Menu_Settings
data.comment: Top-level menu item. Opens the settings window.

data.name: Menu_Help
data.comment: Top-level menu item.

data.name: Menu_HelpContents
data.comment: Help menu item. Opens the online help page in a web browser.

data.name: Menu_HelpAbout
data.comment: Help menu item. {0} is the application name.

data.name: Common_Close
data.comment: Button that closes a dialog window.

data.name: Settings_Title
data.comment: Window title.

data.name: Settings_ComingSoon
data.value: Settings will appear here in a future release.

data.name: About_Title
data.comment: Window title. {0} is the application name.

data.name: About_Version
data.comment: {0} is a version number such as 0.6.2.

data.name: About_DevelopedBy
data.comment: {0} is the developer's name and callsign.

data.name: About_License
data.comment: {0} is the license name, e.g. GPL v3.

data.name: About_Website
data.comment: Link that opens the product web page in a browser.

data.name: About_SourceCode
data.comment: Link that opens the GitHub repository in a browser.

data.name: About_Channel
data.comment: {0} is the channel (alpha, beta, stable); {1} is a date like 2026-09-21.

data.name: About_Expires
data.comment: {0} is the channel; {1} is a date like 2026-10-21.

data.name: Expiry_TitleBar
data.comment: Appended to the window title on alpha and beta builds. {0} is a date.

data.name: Expiry_Warning
data.value: This {0} build expires in {1} day(s), on {2}. Download the current build from the Help menu.
data.comment: Status strip message in the final days before expiry. {0} channel, {1} number of days, {2} date.

data.name: Expiry_WarningToday
data.value: This {0} build expires today. Download the current build from the Help menu.
data.comment: Status strip message on the last day. {0} is the channel.

data.name: Expiry_BetaExpired
data.value: This beta build expired on {0}. It still runs, but a newer build is available.
data.comment: Status strip message on an expired beta. {0} is a date.

data.name: Expired_Title
data.comment: Window title of the dialog shown when an expired alpha is started. {0} is the app name.

data.name: Expired_Message
data.value:
This alpha build of {0} expired on {1}.
Alpha builds stop running after {2} days so that testers always use current code. Please download the latest build.
data.comment: {0} app name, {1} date, {2} number of days.

data.name: Expired_Download
data.comment: Button. Opens the releases page in a web browser.

data.name: Menu_HelpDownload
data.comment: Help menu item. Opens the releases page in a web browser.

data.name: Ready_ChooseRadio
data.value: Choose your radio from the Quick preset list.
data.comment: Shown in the status strip until a radio is selected.

data.name: Ready_SelectPort
data.value: Select the COM port your radio is connected to.
data.comment: Shown in the status strip until a port is selected.

data.name: Placeholder_ChooseRadio
data.comment: Grey placeholder text inside the empty preset dropdown.

data.name: Placeholder_SelectPort
data.comment: Grey placeholder text inside the empty COM port dropdown.

data.name: Option_RadioDefault
data.comment: First choice in every serial setting dropdown. Means: let Hamlib decide.

data.name: Option_Even
data.comment: Serial parity.

data.name: Option_Odd
data.comment: Serial parity.

data.name: Option_Mark
data.comment: Serial parity.

data.name: Option_Space
data.comment: Serial parity.

data.name: Option_Hardware
data.comment: Serial flow control (RTS/CTS).

data.name: Option_Software
data.comment: Serial flow control (XON/XOFF).

data.name: Option_CAT
data.comment: PTT method. Amateur radio term, usually left untranslated.

data.name: Option_RTS
data.comment: PTT method via serial RTS line. Usually left untranslated.

data.name: Option_DTR
data.comment: PTT method via serial DTR line. Usually left untranslated.

data.comment: PTT method. Amateur radio term, usually left untranslated.
